people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
translations.bsb: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
translations.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
translations.asv: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye; for I know that ye seek Jesus, who hath been crucified.
